purpose: Readability and packet-completeness gate only; not semantic lesson review or authoring.
scope: The 21 unchanged queue studio IDs. Required packet is presentation, official associated PRS, and assigned reading portions. No lab manuals or linked external applet/video functionality added to the packet.

method.inventory: Resolved actual links from the official lecture-notes index and official resource landing pages.
method.retrieval_and_decode: All 56 PDF downloads retained with SHA-256; every PDF page decoded and rendered with PyMuPDF at 1.6x.
method.visual: Every source PDF page actually viewed in contact images with 720px-wide page tiles; fine equations, symbols and figure labels received native-page or 5x detail follow-ups where needed. Text extraction and successful rendering alone were never used to grant eligibility.
method.gate: An unresolved required label, symbol, question, diagram annotation or claim blocks the session. A source artifact is nonblocking only when its required role/content is explicitly recoverable within the published packet. Scientific correctness was not scored by this audit.
method.reading_boundaries: Section headings establish assigned spans; inclusive page ranges contain partial boundary pages, with precise start/end notes. Full chapter files were inspected for visual coverage; only assigned portions determine a session reading gate.

blocking_findings.reason: Chapter 1 section 1.2.1, PDF page 6 (printed page 5), Figure 1.2.4: several numeric contour-level labels merge into dense raster linework and remain unreliably legible in the native page and 5x detail render.
